note: SUPPLIED, NOT COLLECTED. Pasted in by the operator on 21 Sep 2026 from a Haidilao US store
list. The original URL was not recorded, and this project could not find the page: the
eportal platform behind haidilao.com exposes exactly this shape at
POST /eportal/store/listShowStore, but that host only ever serves Greater China (1,493
stores, countryId CN/HK/MO/TW) whatever country parameter is passed, superhiinternational.com
does not expose the endpoint at all, and haidilao.us, hdlus.com and haidilaousa.com do not
resolve. The 'distance' field in the pasted text means it came from a locator that sorts by
proximity — so a US edition of that platform exists somewhere.
Until the URL is known this cannot be re-fetched, cannot be diffed tomorrow, and must not be
mistaken for a daily series. It is a dated snapshot with a named human source, which is worth
more than nothing and less than a capture.

supersedes.source: Super Hi International's own /eportal/earth/list country endpoint, read 2026-09-21
finding: This list has 15 restaurants across 15 distinct cities. The parent's own country endpoint
understates its US estate by two restaurants and badly understates the city count. That is
the first hard corroboration result in this project, and it points the wrong way from the
usual assumption: the company's published summary is less accurate than its own locator.
